accumulation.value: Sum over `scale` steps; a window holding a NaN is NaN; first scale-1 steps NaN

calendar_grouping.value: Calendar month (12) or day of year on a 366-column calendar, every year a leap year; Feb 29 interpolated in non-leap years

calibration_period.value: Required calibration_year_initial/final; parameters fit on that window, every year standardized against it; a window the record does not cover is clamped to the record (a window ending one year past it keeps its start) with CalibrationPeriodClampedWarning. The 30-year minimum raises InsufficientDataError only in the xarray adapter, for an in-memory single series containing NaN; the NumPy functions only warn (ShortCalibrationWarning)

distribution.value: Chosen by required `distribution`: gamma or Pearson Type III; Pearson falls back to gamma on a failed fit or more than 50% lost values; log-logistic and GEV rejected by spi()

estimator.value: Gamma: Thom (1958) closed-form approximation to maximum likelihood on non-zero calibration values. Pearson: Hosking SAMLMR sample L-moments (unbiased PWM) on non-zero values

location_offset.value: Gamma has no location (scale and shape only); Pearson fits a location; no offset added; negative precipitation clipped to zero before fitting

zero_handling.value: Mixed CDF p0 + (1-p0)F(x), p0 = zeros / non-missing calibration values per calendar step; a zero scores Phi^-1(p0) ('classic', the top of the zero mass). For Pearson, a support-limit mask can override that score and values below 0.0005 are placed with the zeros

plotting_position.value: Parametric fit; the empirical path is in the non-parametric family

inverse_normal.value: Exact: scipy.stats.norm.ppf (or the Rust norm_ppf kernel)

output_bound.value: Clipped to [-3.09, 3.09] on the normal scale; output_scale='probability' is unclipped, 'bounded' is 2p-1

missing_data_minimum_sample.value: NaN in a window gives NaN; fit uses the non-missing calibration values; Pearson L-moments need at least 4 non-zero values; no explicit minimum for gamma

fit_failure.value: Pearson falls back to gamma with a warning. Gamma: a step with no fittable sample has NaN parameters and its non-zero values score NaN with no fit warning (the goodness-of-fit check skips invalid parameters); an all-zero calibration step scores its zeros -inf, clipped to -3.09; a step with no calibration data has undefined zero mass and its zeros are NaN

accumulation.value: Input resampled to `freq` by mean only when its frequency differs (so daily to monthly gives a mean daily rate, not a total), then rolling MEAN over `window` (default 1, no rolling) with skipna=False; NaN propagates; first window-1 steps NaN

calendar_grouping.value: Month (freq MS), ISO week (W) or day of year (D), by the input frequency. Day of year is the raw time.dayofyear (a leap year's dates after 28 February sit one later), and fitted parameters are re-mapped to the target calendar with resample_doy

calibration_period.value: cal_start/cal_end slice (default whole input); fit parameters from an earlier fit passed as `params` override it

options.value: any scipy or lmoments3 distribution object

estimator.value: method='ML': scipy maximum likelihood started from _fit_start values

options.value: APP: Thom closed form for gamma on the values with x - floc > 0 (others are dropped from the fit but still scored), requires floc

location_offset.value: ML fits a free location unless `floc` is passed in fitkwargs; APP requires floc

zero_handling.value: zero_inflated=True: zeros removed from the fit; p0 = zeros / non-NaN observations, zeros included ('ecdf'); zeros placed at the upper bound of the zero mass, as 'classic'

options.value: Zero at the midpoint of its rank interval

zero_handling.note: 'center' is the midpoint of the zero ranks, not p0/2 as the library's center_of_mass.
